notes:
Artifacts: Agents in BaoCut conversations now make slides, documents, designs and other artifacts through the bundled Open Artifact. Ask for one or type /artifacts. Finished artifacts appear as cards in the conversation and open in an artifact tab, where comments sent to the agent return to the conversation that made them. Deleting or sharing an artifact always asks for approval.
Removed: The built-in slides, design, design system and docs editors and their agent tools are gone. Existing deck, design and document folders in a workspace are not migrated and stay as ordinary folders in Files; their old receipts no longer show in conversations.
Review page export: The review page opened in an agent's browser now has Export. It exports this video as MP4 to the project's exports folder; size and burned-in captions are the only choices, and Copy equivalent command gives the matching baocut export line.
Web exports: In a browser, finished exports show the file path with Copy path and Download instead of Show in folder, including each file of a multi-file export and partial outputs of cancelled or failed exports.
OpenAI-compatible API: /v1/audio/transcriptions accepts response_format=diarized_json and returns segments labeled by speaker (A, B, ...). Use MOSS Transcribe, or Qwen3-ASR or Whisper with the Speaker diarization component installed; other models return 400. known_speaker_names and known_speaker_references are not supported.
Known limits: Artifact tabs open only on the computer running BaoCut, not in remote web clients. Artifacts are not included in portable exports, and after a conversation is forked its artifacts stay with the original conversation. BaoCut's MCP service and CLI do not offer artifact tools; external agents use Open Artifact directly.
The macOS package requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14 or later. Windows packages are unsigned and require AVX2 and the Microsoft Visual C++ v14 x64 Redistributable. CUDA and Vulkan variants require compatible GPU drivers.
